prompt: How will the software initially be introduced?

options.text: Through a limited trial with selected businesses
options.whyZh: 先給五十家自願商戶用一週，再評估問題。

options.text: By replacing every customer's old version immediately
options.zh: 立即替換所有客戶舊版
options.whyZh: 講者明說今天不對所有客戶開放。
它是有共用檢視的軟體應用程式。
試用對象是五十家自願參加的商家，不是文件團隊。

explanationZh: 先給五十家自願商戶用一週，再評估問題。
evidence: fifty volunteer businesses will use it for one week

vocabulary.note: 共享檢視顯示員工日程中的空閒時間。
